date_note: Disclosed in a regulatory filing 'on Monday' (23 November) per IANS; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Suzlon Energy says it has reported a cybersecurity incident to CERT-In and sees no impact on business-critical applications so far.
geo_basis: country; the source gives no city
plain: Indian wind-energy company Suzlon says it had a cybersecurity incident, has reported it to India's national cyber agency and has taken containment steps. It says business-critical applications are not affected so far.
summary: Suzlon Energy disclosed a cybersecurity incident in a regulatory filing on Monday, IANS reports. The company says it activated incident response mechanisms, took immediate containment measures and reported the matter to CERT-In. Suzlon says no impact is observed on business-critical applications at this stage. The article gives no detail on the nature of the incident.
title: Suzlon Energy says it reported a cyber incident to CERT-In

validation.note: One publisher (IANS) relaying Suzlon's regulatory filing; the filing itself was not read.
